authorization: Explicit user authorization for coordinator plus three specialist agents; full216chapter goal remains active.
workflow: No child agents, shared-file edits or publishing; coordinator alone owns canonical state, source catalogue, shared verifier and hosting.
Inspect actual primary sources for unresolved method/current institutional facts; reuse verified chapter sources where sufficient, recording exact scope. No observed data invented.
Send a compact early model/units/timing outline with independently checkable original numerical anchors. Define assumptions and boundaries before using results.
Use static HTML and standard-library Python only. Original problems with full solutions, quiet JSON-serializable check(), scoped author record and exact final SHA256 hashes.
Return material findings honestly. No claims of accreditation, guaranteed exam success or appointments. Visual/mobile/print UI QA remains pending.
Drafting can proceed against fixed prerequisite contracts, but acceptance follows the canonical dependency graph. Preserve all accepted source and manuscripts.
shared_interface: All account names include currency, period and reporting entity; debit and credit mean ledger sides, not universal increases or decreases.
Use one explicit fictional business convention for numerical examples. Separate the accounting equation and double entry from jurisdiction-dependent recognition/measurement rules.
GAAP/IFRS distinctions require actual dated primary standards or regulator sources; an introductory ledger is not a current legal-compliance manual.

Financial statement models must reconcile opening stocks, current flows, retained earnings and ending cash; noncash expense is not cash outflow, owner contributions/distributions are not revenue/expense.
Canonical G in national accounts is government consumption and I includes all investment; accounting business revenue and GDP/value added are distinct objects.
New assessment problems must transfer learned methods; do not merely substitute numbers in an existing chapter exercise or require an untaught graduate theorem.
